List the available palettes

Source: R/palettes.R
tf_palette_names.Rd

List the available palettes

Usage

tf_palette_names(faction = NULL, team = NULL, role = NULL, medium = "toy")

Arguments

faction

Optional faction (see tf_factions()) to restrict the list to. Matched case-insensitively and by unique prefix, so "auto" works.

team

Optional team or subgroup (see tf_teams()) to restrict the list to, matched the same way.

role

Optional role to restrict the list to: one of "leader", "combiner torso", "combiner limb", "combined form" or "subgroup member", matched the same way.

medium

Which medium's palettes to list: "toy" (default), "cartoon", "comic", "g2", or "all" for every palette regardless of medium. See tf_media().

Value

A character vector of palette names accepted by tf_palette() and the scale_*_tf() functions.

Examples

tf_palette_names()
#>   [1] "optimus_prime"  "megatron"       "shockwave"      "soundwave"     
#>   [5] "silverbolt"     "air_raid"       "fireflight"     "skydive"       
#>   [9] "slingshot"      "superion"       "hot_spot"       "streetwise"    
#>  [13] "blades"         "groove"         "first_aid"      "defensor"
